quest.title: Static Views
quest.description: Paimon found a painting in Vanarana that could be a treasure map...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Let Paimon see... Hmm? Is this an Aranara painting...?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Hmm... Who knows how many adventurer camps and treasure chests we have rummaged through!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Let's put it this way. We didn't see Aranara anywhere near the house, and we were worried, so we'd rather see if there were any leads. We might even help some trapped Aranara!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Of course! Anyway, seems like the painting depicts some views near here, right? Ah, maybe it's a treasure map...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: #{NICKNAME}, we should go to the spot shown in the painting! Maybe we'll find some treasure left by the Aranara!

talks.objective: Proceed to the location shown in the painting

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Hmm... Let's take a look. It seems like a new treasure map!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Aren't we going to help "the trapped Aranara"?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: #Ahem! We haven't found the house owner. This is worrying! So, {NICKNAME}, why don't we check some other places shown in the painting?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: After we get there, we could...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Yes! Wait, Paimon means... no! Find the trapped Aranara!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: And what an interesting "mailbox." It may receive some new paintings later. We should keep an eye on it!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Yes! We might even find some treasure!
